ammonia.reason: Surface deamination of amino acids by Brevibacterium / smear flora raises surface NH3, milder than Limburger.

animal_barnyard.reason: Brevibacterium linens / aurantiacum catabolism of aromatic amino acids to p-cresol, indole and phenols in smear.

bitter.reason: Moderate hydrophobic peptides from rennet and mesophilic starter proteolysis, mostly trimmed by smear peptidases.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti inoculation and no methyl-ketone blue pathway in washed-rind make.

browning.reason: Residual lactose/galactose plus free amino acids support moderate Maillard on heating in semi-soft paste.

buttery.reason: Diacetyl/acetoin from citrate-positive mesophilic lactococci plus lactones from milk fat lipolysis.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Butanoic and 3-methylbutanoic acids from lipolysis and leucine catabolism by starter and smear bacteria.

creaminess.reason: High moisture ~46% and fat 31.2% with smear proteolysis softening paste to pliable creamy texture.

crumbliness.reason: Rennet-gelled, washed, smear-ripened paste demineralizes and proteolyzes to pliable not crumbly body.

firmness.reason: Semisoft washed-rind with 43-49% moisture, light pressing gives sliceable but yielding paste.

floral_honey.reason: Low phenylacetaldehyde/2-phenylethanol from phenylalanine catabolism by lactococci and smear yeasts.

fruity.reason: Ethyl butanoate/hexanoate from esterification of free fatty acids with ethanol by smear yeasts and bacteria.

goaty.reason: Cow milk low in 4-methyloctanoic/4-ethyloctanoic acids, no goat-milk branched-chain fatty acid signature.

malty_nutty.reason: 3-methylbutanal from leucine Strecker degradation and early Maillard, plus proteolysis-derived pyrazines.

melt.reason: Rennet-coagulated pH ~6.0 intact calcium-paracasein network flows well on heating, not acid-set.

mushroom_earthy.reason: 1-octen-3-ol and geosmin-type notes from smear yeasts and surface microflora, described as hay/wet soil.

oil_off.reason: Moderate free oil release from 31.2% fat semi-soft matrix on melting, less than hard grana.

smoky.reason: No smoking step and no guaiacol/phenol wood-smoke deposition in traditional Durrus make.

sour_vinegar.reason: Lactic acid from mesophilic starter plus low acetic acid from heterofermentative and smear metabolism.

stretch.reason: No pasta-filata hot-water stretching or acid-calcium phosphate rearrangement for fiber formation.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Methanethiol and dimethyl sulfides from methionine gamma-lyase activity of Brevibacterium in smear.

sweet.reason: Most lactose fermented, slight sweetness from residual lactose, glycerol and masking by fat.

umami.reason: Free glutamate accumulation from rennet/chymosin and starter/smear proteolysis during 6-8 week ripening.
